通过网页抓取获取 GitHub 按日/周/月增长的热门仓库。当用户询问 GitHub 趋势、热门项目、本周热点或「什么在 GitHub 上 trending」时使用。可输出列表或 JSON，无需 API Key。

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the **GitHub Trending skill**.
- Fetches GitHub trending repositories by day, week, or month—no API key required.
- Supports language filtering and outputs results as formatted text or JSON.
- Pure Python standard library implementation; no external packages needed.
- Ideal for displaying currently popular GitHub projects, stats, and hot repos on request.
